## Numerical Linear Algebra and Statistical Computing

**Term:** Fall 2024, Fall 2025, Fall 2026  
**Instructor:** Yun Wei

## Course description

This graduate course covers numerical linear algebra and statistical computing, including matrix decomposition, optimization, and machine learning.
